pr_title: Read base requirements from `pyproject.toml` in `uv run`
pr_body:
In addition to the requested requirements, we include requirements from a `pyproject.toml` file if it exists and install the current directory.

Closes https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/3104

issue_context.title: Allow requested requirements to override base requirements in `uv run`
issue_context.body: Following https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/3101 we include the project requirements as a base, any requested requirements should replace those in the base project if duplicated instead of throwing an error.

review_comments: cc @charliermarsh minor note for consideration in your design
I feel like this should still be looking up the ancestor hierarchy recursively?
